## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. It starts at Yas Island, Abu Dhabi.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Let the fun commence in Abu Dhabi's best theme parks! Your ticket gets you unlimited access to three theme parks across three fun-packed days. Enjoy the entertainment at Ferrari World, Warner Bros. World™ Abu Dhabi, SeaWorld and Yas Waterworld, in any order you like!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €150.18. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 61 ratings and 24 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
